scope: Bounded candidate mathematical validation on supplied synthetic integer labels and coordinates only; no images, detector, real-pixel quality or native performance claim

input_transport.arguments: Exactly one binary seekable file path, no stdin or delegated process
input_transport.encoding: ASCII printable characters and SPACE,TAB,CR,VT,FF,LF only; NUL/non-ASCII/other control bytes rejected
input_transport.framing: One request per LF-separated line; final nonempty line may omit LF; blank/separator-only lines are fatal
input_transport.empty_file: Valid zero-request batch; empty stdout and exit 0
input_transport.bounds: Initial input size and consumed bytes checked; each line push is checked before growth; count/grid caps validated before allocation/loops

input_grammar.request: C1 request_id template_width template_height scene_width scene_height tl_x tl_y match_x match_y padding_left padding_top padding_right padding_bottom template_label*(template_width*template_height) scene_label*(scene_width*scene_height)
input_grammar.label_order: Both complete label arrays are row-major, y then x, template array first
input_grammar.unsigned_integer: One to 20 ASCII decimal digits, leading zeros permitted, no sign/decimal point/exponent; pre-multiply/add checked against uint64 max18446744073709551615
input_grammar.unsigned_fields: request_id, all four dimensions and every label
input_grammar.signed_integer: One to 20 ASCII bytes comprising optional single leading minus followed by at least one decimal digit; leading zeros and -0 allowed, plus sign/decimal point/exponent forbidden. Checked magnitude permits [-9223372036854775808,9223372036854775807] without negating INT64_MIN.
input_grammar.signed_fields: tl_x,tl_y,match_x,match_y and all four padding entries
input_grammar.dimensions: Each dimension in1..16; each grid <=256 cells checked by division before allocation
input_grammar.padding: Nonnegative, opposing sums checked signed64, each sum strictly below padded scene dimension
input_grammar.coordinate_domain: Every sampled canvas-minus-tl, match-plus-relative, and padded-minus-left/top scalar stage must fit signed64, even if later cancellation or outside bounds could hide overflow; driver prechecks this before scoring
input_grammar.template: Must retain at least one physical pixel after thinning; all-invalid/wholly erased template is fatal, while empty scene is valid
input_grammar.oracle_domain: Every template chain has <=8 owned samples and EVERY scene chain has <=8 physical vertices, including unused chains; no truncation, omission or silent skipping
input_grammar.request_ids: May repeat; callers requiring unique association enforce uniqueness
input_grammar.completeness: Exactly the counted labels and no extra tokens; validate the whole request before numerical scoring

validation_driver_limits_only.maximum_single_record_bytes_including_lf: Remaining cumulative stdout budget, at most67108864
validation_driver_limits_only.integer_bound: At most16 occupied cells each count<=256, so LCM<=256^16 and D<=16*256^16; numerators are <=D. 128digits is a deliberately loose checked serialization cap.
validation_driver_limits_only.scope: Driver limits do not limit native API mathematics; external wall/working-set/output guards are still required and are not an OS allocation sandbox or aggregate RSS bound

scene.thinning: Full Python-named ThinningResult: width,height,eligible_labels,labels,round_deletions, all complete arrays and final[0,0]round
scene.chains: Full Chain records: chain_id,pixel_ids,closed,returning, retaining canonical full topology and flags
scene.memberships: All surviving physical pixels in ID order, each{pixel_id,members}; each member{chain_id,chain_index}, including unsampled vertices and every shared junction membership

score.samples: Complete SampleSupport rows with keys sample_id,p_canvas,relative,q_padded,q_original,padded_in_bounds,original_in_bounds,compatible_pixel_ids,independent_witness. Each point is a two-integer JSON array; independent_witness is integer or null.
score.chains: Complete observable core results with keys template_chain_id,numerator,independent_numerator,total_weight,case,witness. Native selected_case is serialized as Python-named case: null or{scene_chain_id,direction,template_cut,scene_cut}. Witness is complete original-ID pair arrays in solver order.
score.counters: The sole omitted native field is work. Work counters are neither serialized nor independently validated by this candidate audit; no counter agreement claim follows.
score.diagnostics: Outside-ID arrays, independent witness pairs, and cross-chain reused-ID arrays are complete and retain native ordering; all template chains including zero-owned results are present

output_transport.format: Compact ASCII JSON Lines, no spaces between tokens, each full record followed by LF and flushed; Windows stdout binary
output_transport.numerics: Every integer including GMP numerator/denominator is an exact canonical JSON numeric token, no floating-point conversion, exponent notation or numeric strings; booleans are true/false
output_transport.reader_requirement: An exact-integer JSON parser, such as Python json.loads; IEEE754double coercion can lose IDs and weights
output_transport.assembly: Every append reserves LF and checks the remaining stdout allowance before allocation; assemble the full success record before write, charge the full attempted write before OS output, and never reuse that allowance after partial I/O failure
output_transport.error_record: Fixed object{request_id:integer,error:ERROR_CODEstring}, followed by LF if it fits remaining allowance; fallback request_id0 before ID parsing or during line/file/request-limit rejection
output_transport.error_budget: If stdout is unusable or no error object fits, retain nonzero exit and attempt fixed bounded stderr diagnostic; I/O failure can physically truncate a record

fatal_error_codes_exit_1.INPUT_LIMIT: Input initially or while reading exceeds64MiB
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.EXTRA_TOKEN: Extra token follows complete counted labels
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.INTEGER_TOKEN_LIMIT: Unsigned/signed integer token empty or exceeds20bytes
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.SIGNED_DECIMAL: Signed token is malformed, plus sign included
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.CELL_LIMIT: Grid exceeds256cells; current per-axis cap already implies this bound
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.PADDING_EXTENT: Padding removes whole original width or height
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.TEMPLATE_EMPTY: Template has no surviving physical pixel after thinning
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.ORACLE_CHAIN_LIMIT: Template owned count or any scene chain exceeds eight-point finite reference cap
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.COORDINATE_DOMAIN: A scalar pose-frame operation exceeds signed64
fatal_error_codes_exit_1.OUTPUT_LIMIT: Complete next response cannot fit cumulative stdout budget

fatal_failures_exit_2.CLI: Wrong argument count; fixed stderr usage, no JSON error
fatal_failures_exit_2.BINARY_STDOUT: Windows binary stdout setup failure; fixed stderr, no JSON error
fatal_failures_exit_2.FACTORY_INVALID_EVIDENCE: Unexpected invalid_argument after independent driver domain validation
fatal_failures_exit_2.FACTORY_OVERFLOW: Native count overflow or exact integer outside bounded serialization domain
fatal_failures_exit_2.INTERNAL_ERROR: Other unexpected exception, including score invariant failure

termination: Stop at first fatal request, retain earlier complete results, evaluate no later request. Audit success requires exit0 and exactly one fully matching recursively typed success object for every expected request; errors or missing/extra records are fatal.
audit_domain: Exact V33 candidate-oracle exhaustive domain:5123x3 scene occupancies*2fixed direction profiles*3<=3owned-sample templates*2coordinate/padding transforms=6144cases, no skips. Expected scene and score fields originate only from independent_candidate_oracle and its independent edge/partial-injection references.
execution_claim: Prepared source-only; parent owns guarded build/generation/native execution/audit. No malformed-input stress campaign, counter oracle, image correctness or native performance result is claimed by this protocol.
